Subject: Internal: proposal frames for Valencia (floor / pilot / ramp tiers)

Sofia / Dylan — drafting commercial frames for Valencia. Below are three distinct options we can present (priced in committed-GPU-equivalents):

Option A — Pilot-then-floor (Conservative)
- Pilot: 8 A100s (2 weeks) — validation and evaluation
- Floor: 24 GPUs reserved (minimum) — supports daytime SLA 95th pct latency target
- Ramp: increase to 48 GPUs over 4 months by pre-agreed milestones
- Pricing: fixed monthly reservation fee + burst pool at 2.5x on-demand rate

Option B — Smoothing (Business-friendly)
- Pilot: 8 A100s (2 weeks)
- Floor: 16 GPUs reserved with a 40% burst buffer (paid as committed smoothing)
- Ramp: 16 -> 32 GPUs across 8–12 weeks, flexible review cadence
- Pricing: blended commit + overage discounts once floor exceeded

Option C — Aggressive Onramp (fast growth)
- Pilot: 12 GPUs (short alpha)
- Floor: start at 24 GPUs but with automated managed scaling to 64 GPUs within 3 months (commit to smoothing band)
- Pricing: higher upfront commitment discount; SLA guarantee on daytime throughput

Key commercial levers to highlight to the customer: metered burst, smoothing/commit blending, short-term trial credits, and an SLA uplift with a dedicated support add-on.

I'll bake numbers into a proposal doc once Sofia confirms which frame Valencia favors.

—Marissa

Chris/Sofia — quick engineering notes after skimming the workload profile:
- Latency target (95th < 350ms) for triage with max seq len ~1024 is achievable on a 24-GPU floor with batching and short prefix caching.
- Pilot (8 GPUs) is realistic for functional validation but won't hit production tail latency; use it for correctness + throughput characterization.
- Burst: recommend a 12-hour rolling burst bucket (configurable) backed by spare capacity in our regional pool; can be throttled to preserve tail latency for core traffic.
- KV cache hit improvements (prefix cache) could reduce cost by ~18% on your profile. We can prepare a micro-benchmark during the pilot.

I'll prepare a short tech appendix to include with the commercial proposal.

- Floor: 16 GPUs reserved, monthly reservation fee, daytime SLA: 95th percentile latency target (we'll include exact numbers in the SOW)
